pages.title: A Pickaxe With a Taste for Blood
pages.text: This pickaxe comes with Efficiency V, Fortune III and Mending. Simply holding it grants Haste II, making it exceptionally quick for mining.

$(bold)But at what cost?$()$(br)It has the durability of a gold-tier tool, and rather than breaking when that runs out it keeps working by draining your own health — as long as you can afford the price.$(br2)Mending still works normally, so keep gaining experience while you mine.
